info.name: Notification Module
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Notification module.

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/companies/{{company_id}}/notifications

All routes require:
- Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
- Content-Type: application/json

request.description:
Fetch all notification templates for a company (includes global system templates + company overrides).

Role required: Admin
